title: bread keepers
text: bread keepers. I purchased these to put some festive holiday loafs in... BUT they are too narrow.  The measurements of the loaf pan were spot on and this would have worked, but the measurements given on the keepers are not the inside, they are the outside measurements.  Eh.  Donated all of them and have to come up with a different plan for my gifts.
